scope: Static generic HuiSlider implementation; actual EQ object adapter/configuration and live behavior unverified.

state.last_input_prefix: owner+0xe0 receives first8 bytes of raw input unconditionally at entry0x21ef320
state.interface_offset: IHuiSlider subobject at owner+0xc0; getter0x21f7580 reads relative+0x18

conversion.scale: adapter unsigned32 denominator+12 and float multiplier+16
conversion.override: Custom adapter virtual+24 may supply another range; actual EQ adapter unresolved.
conversion.limitations: No inference of a specific ADC resolution, denominator or EQ center from generic code.

update.adapter_validation: Existence token at adapter+8 checked against initialized expected token; conversion via adapter virtual+16.

change_threshold.comparison: Suppress when abs(converted-current) < threshold; before clamping. This also suppresses raw-only changes when converted value is unchanged.

update.generic_clamp: Finite converted values bounded to -1..1. Not proof that EQ uses bipolar range.
update.accepted_value: Stores clamped float at owner+216 and unchanged raw event uint32+8 at owner+220.
update.queue: Appends8-byte float/raw pair to owner+160 array, count+176, capacity+168; can malloc/realloc.
update.nan: Nonfinite behavior not validated; no clean rejection claim.

notification: 0x21f4950 validates observer lifetime token, obtains current HUI ID, passes interface owner+0xc0 and payload to observer virtual+16; mapped HuiEventHandler consumes float/raw.
next: Resolve current EQ adapter configuration and valid raw-input semantics.
Trace queue consumer scheduling and verify live raw/float correspondence.
Integrate normalized software EQ commands only after per-knob range/center is established.

live_eq_configuration.limitation: Static conversion plus live configuration; nonzero injected-input correspondence and physical knob center not yet measured.
